# Version 4.150.6 (Unreleased)
> **Ganesh failure handling**

## Highlights

The collected 4.150.6 changes improve Ganesh failure tracking and GPU buffer-upload checks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed tasks remain failed through flush** — Separates whether a render task executed from whether it succeeded, including intermediate GPU submission failures. Existing managed flush signatures remain unchanged. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258))
- **GPU upload failures are checked** — Adds checked buffer-upload and initialization paths to reduce stale drawing under GPU memory pressure, and retains CPU triangulation data for retries. This does not establish complete coverage of every upload-failure path. ([#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))
